# Funnelling Revenue

> Revenue-first marketing agency for manufacturers and industrial brands. We engineer SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and revenue-driven content — measured on pipeline, not traffic.

The funnel is eternal. The medium isn't. Newspapers, radio, television, search, social, and now AI have each reinvented the channel; none has reinvented the buyer. Founded by Shubham Walwadkar, a mechanical engineer turned marketing strategist with 8+ years across Pall Corporation, Sany India, and the Danaher Lifesciences portfolio.

## Positioning
- Serves manufacturers and industrial brands exclusively — not a generalist agency.
- Reports on qualified leads, pipeline value, CAC, LTV, deal velocity, and revenue attribution — never impressions, sessions, or vanity rankings.
- Every service maps to a funnel stage: ToFu (top of funnel), MoFu (middle of funnel), or BoFu (bottom of funnel).

## Services
- [SEO for Manufacturers](https://funnellingrevenue.com/services/seo/): Technical SEO, topic clusters, and buyer-persona keyword research for industrial sites.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://funnellingrevenue.com/services/geo/): Getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini for category and vendor queries.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://funnellingrevenue.com/services/aeo/): Winning the Reddit, Quora, and FAQ surfaces buyers check before shortlisting a vendor.
- [Revenue-Driven Content](https://funnellingrevenue.com/services/content/): Content briefs and clusters mapped to pipeline stage, not publishing cadence.
- [Paid Media](https://funnellingrevenue.com/services/paid/): Performance marketing measured on qualified leads and ROAS.
- [Fractional Marketing Leadership](https://funnellingrevenue.com/services/fractional/): Senior marketing ownership without a full-time hire.

## Proof
- [Pall Corporation](https://funnellingrevenue.com/case-studies/pall-corporation/): 178% priority-segment traffic growth via topic cluster strategy; 2,100 internal links.
- [Sany India](https://funnellingrevenue.com/case-studies/sany-india/): First-ever organic leads; 2x organic traffic and 225% lead growth in 4 months.
- [Industrial Revenue Recovery](https://funnellingrevenue.com/case-studies/industrial-revenue-recovery/): ₹3Cr+ organic revenue in Q1 from a 17-year-old industrial website (anonymised).

## Free tools
- [Website Revenue Audit](https://funnellingrevenue.com/tools/website-revenue-audit/): Paste a URL for a 0-100 technical, on-page and funnel-coverage score.
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://funnellingrevenue.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker/): Tests AI-crawler access, llms.txt, entity markup and citable content structure.
- [SERP & Meta Previewer](https://funnellingrevenue.com/tools/serp-meta-previewer/): Google and social previews with length checks and a suggested rewrite.
- [Funnel Revenue Calculator](https://funnellingrevenue.com/tools/funnel-revenue-calculator/): Model visitor-to-revenue conversion and see which stage is worth most.
